d:
This is a 5 part series (as of writing this), but I currently only have raws for parts 1, 4, and 5. I intend to do all five, but that will be once I get the rest of the raws.

I'm sick, so I'm not feeling up to saying much else here. I guess one note. The dark elf lady's skill was awkward to translate, because it included the word "ken" which is pretty dang specific to swords. But she's using a hammer. I went with "blade" for the translation because it was the more generalist.
